settings.tagline: Where Every Heart Finds a Place.
settings.heroHeadline: More Than a Place to Gather. A Place to Belong.
settings.heroSubheadline: Rooted in prayer, united in worship and driven by compassion. At GLOW Church Africa, we believe God's love is best demonstrated not only through what we profess, but also through how we serve, care and show up for one another.
settings.welcomeHeadline: A Prayer Movement & Worship Community Across Denominational Lines
settings.welcomeBody: GLOW Church Africa is an interdenominational prayer and worship movement. More than a conventional church institution, we are a welcoming sanctuary where people from every background, tradition, and walk of life can seek God in prayer, experience genuine fellowship, and join hands in practical compassion.
settings.prayerInvitation: Whatever season of life you find yourself in, you do not have to carry everything alone. We would be honoured to stand with you in prayer.
settings.closingStatement: At GLOW, we believe that love should be experienced, faith should be lived and no one should have to walk alone.

announcements.title: Weekly Interdenominational Prayer Watch
announcements.message: All believers and seekers from every church background are warmly welcome to join our upcoming worship and prayer gatherings.

impactProjects.title: Community Care & Nourishment Outreach
impactProjects.summary: Volunteers came together to prepare and share fresh food parcels and household essentials with families walking through difficult seasons.
impactProjects.whatWasDone: GLOW members and partner volunteers gathered fresh produce, staple pantry supplies, and hygiene necessities, organizing an open-courtyard distribution focused on warm hospitality and personal conversation.
impactProjects.whyItMattered: Dignity matters just as much as provision. Rather than treating outreach as a distant transaction, we wanted neighbours to be greeted by name, listened to, and cared for without judgement.
impactProjects.whoItServed: Elderly neighbours, single-parent households, and local families facing acute food insecurity in our surrounding community.
impactProjects.whatGlowHopedToAchieve: To demonstrate that Christian faith is visible through practical kindness—standing beside neighbours in tangible need and building lasting relationships of trust.
impactProjects.documentedStory: Throughout the afternoon, neighbours shared meals, children played in the courtyard, and volunteers stayed long after distribution to pray with families who asked for encouragement. This initiative marked one of our foundational steps in 2024 toward ongoing neighbourhood care.
impactProjects.imageAlt: Community volunteers warmly sharing fresh food parcels with neighbours in a sunlit courtyard

impactProjects.title: Youth Encouragement & Mentorship Circles
impactProjects.summary: Intergenerational mentorship tables creating safe spaces for young people to receive guidance, study support, and spiritual encouragement.
impactProjects.whatWasDone: We hosted welcoming afternoon sessions pairing older community mentors and educators with secondary school youth for open dialogue, study support, and life-skills encouragement.
impactProjects.whyItMattered: Many young people carry quiet pressures around education, purpose, and belonging. Having trusted adults who genuinely listen helps bridge isolation.
impactProjects.whoItServed: Teenagers, students, and young adults from across diverse neighbourhoods regardless of religious background.
impactProjects.whatGlowHopedToAchieve: To cultivate a supportive environment where young people feel seen, valued, and equipped with practical wisdom and hopeful community ties.
impactProjects.documentedStory: Seated around long wooden tables with notebooks and tea, mentors and students reflected on personal goals, resilience, and community responsibility—reinforcing our belief that transformation happens around shared tables.
impactProjects.imageAlt: Community mentors and youth seated together around wooden tables in warm conversation

impactProjects.title: Neighbourhood Prayer & Family Care Visits
impactProjects.summary: Small intercessory fellowship teams visiting bereaved, unwell, and isolated households to sit together, listen, and pray.
impactProjects.whatWasDone: Dedicated prayer and pastoral care volunteers visited homes upon invitation, bringing practical comfort, unhurried companionship, and heartfelt prayer.
impactProjects.whyItMattered: Grief, illness, and hardship often deepen in silence. Showing up in someone’s living room communicates that no household is forgotten.
impactProjects.whoItServed: Families navigating illness, bereavement, or quiet personal transition within our wider community.
impactProjects.whatGlowHopedToAchieve: To carry the warmth of a prayer sanctuary into everyday homes—offering spiritual encouragement anchored in genuine human presence.
impactProjects.documentedStory: In small living rooms lit by afternoon sun, elders and younger believers held hands in quiet prayer—a living picture of interdenominational fellowship where care precedes formality.
impactProjects.imageAlt: Diverse group of believers holding hands in a quiet prayer fellowship circle

impactProjects.title: Sanctuary Doors Open: Evening of Refuge & Care
impactProjects.summary: An open-door evening combining unhurried worship, quiet personal prayer ministry, and warm hospitality for anyone seeking spiritual rest.
impactProjects.whatWasDone: We opened our gathering space for a dusk-to-evening sanctuary session featuring acoustic worship, guided corporate prayer, and one-on-one prayer support alongside shared refreshments.
impactProjects.whyItMattered: People carrying heavy burdens rarely need spectacle; they need a peaceful, welcoming room where God’s presence is honoured and every visitor is received warmly.
impactProjects.whoItServed: Individuals and families from multiple denominations, newcomers to the city, and anyone searching for spiritual refuge.
impactProjects.whatGlowHopedToAchieve: To model a worship environment free of denominational barriers—centred on prayer, humility, and shared grace.
impactProjects.documentedStory: As evening settled over the open timber hall, attendees remained long after the final hymn to pray with one another and share stories of renewed hope.
impactProjects.imageAlt: Peaceful evening prayer sanctuary bathed in candlelight and dusk glow

events.title: Interdenominational Evening of Worship & Intercession
events.venue: GLOW Fellowship Sanctuary (Confirm exact venue in Admin CMS)
events.summary: An unhurried afternoon and evening of Christ-centred worship, scripture reflection, and united prayer for families and communities.
events.description: Join believers from across church traditions for an unhurried gathering devoted to worship and corporate intercession. Whether you have walked in faith for decades or are stepping into a prayer gathering for the first time, there is a seat and a warm welcome waiting for you.
events.registrationNote: Free open gathering. Register below so our hospitality team can prepare warmly for you.
events.imageAlt: Congregation gathered in heartfelt worship and prayer

events.title: Midweek Corporate Prayer Watch
events.summary: A focused midweek hour lifting up submitted prayer needs, local neighbourhoods, and church unity.
events.description: Our midweek prayer watch is the heartbeat of GLOW Church Africa. Together we bring personal burdens, community needs, and prayers for renewal before God with reverence and faith.
events.registrationNote: Open to all. You may attend in person or submit a prayer request beforehand.
events.imageAlt: Small fellowship circle praying together with joined hands

events.title: Monthly Neighbourhood Compassion Outreach
events.summary: Hands-on community care morning sharing food provisions, family encouragement, and neighbourhood fellowship.
events.description: Faith moves outward into the streets and courtyards where our neighbours live. Volunteers gather at 09:30 for brief orientation and prayer before serving meals, distributing care packs, and spending unhurried time listening to local families.
events.registrationNote: Volunteers and first-time helpers are warmly invited to RSVP below.
events.imageAlt: Volunteers distributing fresh produce and care packages in a community courtyard

events.title: Sanctuary Thanksgiving & Prayer Convening
events.summary: A reflective gathering celebrating God’s faithfulness across our communities and praying into the new year.
events.description: As the year closes, we gather across denominations to give thanks for testimonies of grace, remember those we have walked alongside since 2024, and commit our families and cities to God in prayer.
events.registrationNote: Open to individuals, families, and partner fellowships.
events.imageAlt: Candlelit wooden prayer hall prepared for an evening worship service
